question: A can lay railway track between two given stations in 20 days and B can do the same job in 15 days. With the help of C, they did the job in 3 days only. Then, C alone can do the job in
solution:
**Given:**

A can complete the work in 20 days.

B can complete the work in 15 days.

A, B, and C together complete the work in 3 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work rate = 1 / Time

Total work rate = Sum of individual work rates

**Calculation:**

⇒ A’s 1-day work = 1/20

⇒ B’s 1-day work = 1/15
